import re

# Strip line numbers from original
lines = original.split('\n')
clean_original_lines = []
for line in lines:
    # Match pattern: spaces + digits + tab
    m = re.match(r'^(\s*\d+)\t(.*)', line)
    if m:
        clean_original_lines.append(m.group(2))
    else:
        clean_original_lines.append(line)

clean_original = '\n'.join(clean_original_lines)

# Find functions
for i, line in enumerate(clean_original.split('\n')):
    stripped = line.strip()
    if (stripped.startswith('def ') or stripped.startswith('class ')) and not line.startswith(' '):
        print(f"Line {i+1}: {stripped[:70]}")
